facts.business: DJS Stock and Shares Limited operates as a securities brokerage firm in India, offering services in equity trading, mutual funds, portfolio management services (PMS), and advisory offerings.
key_risks: Regulatory compliance risk (e.g., failure to publish financial results in newspapers as per Regulation 47)
Technology and operational risk (peak concurrent loads, server uptime, risk-management architecture)
Market risk (dependence on retail digital participation and market volumes)
